test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.

The baby slept **quiet** through the night.
solution:
The correct answer is '**quietly**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**quietly**" is the correct adverb form of "**quiet**."
 
• In the sentence, "**quietly**" is required to describe how the baby slept, as adverbs modify verbs.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** are incorrect because they are not appropriate adverbs for this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The baby slept **quietly**__ through the night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "calm"** is incorrect because it is an adjective and does not modify the verb "slept" correctly.
 
• **Option 2: "soft"** is incorrect because it is also an adjective and does not fit contextually with the verb.
 
• **Option 3: "peaceful"** is incorrect because it is an adjective and cannot modify the verb "slept" in this context.
